Tension Headache Relief & Prevention
Tension headaches are often triggered by muscle tightness in the neck,
shoulders, or jaw, stress, or eye strain.
Self-Care Comfort Measures: - Heat or Ice Therapy: Apply a warm compress
or heating pad to neck muscles, or a cold pack to the forehead. - Muscle
Relaxation: Perform gentle neck stretches and shoulder rolls. - Hydration:
Sip water steadily, especially after long work sessions or hot weather. -
Rest: Take a break from computer screens every 30-45 minutes.
Ayurveda Context: Traditional Ayurvedic approaches suggest warm forehead
compresses and temple massage with suitable carrier oils for mild tension
relief.
